author: CNN
description:
Gulf oil producers, with considerable support from the US Navy, are jamming crude through the Strait of Hormuz, right under Iran’s nose. Oil and petroleum product flows through the critical chokepoint averaged 13.1 million barrels per day last week, according to Kpler, a marine data tracking service. That’s just under 80% of the 17.1 million barrels that had traveled through the strait each day before the war broke out.

Meanwhile, President Donald Trump is willing to give Iran sanctions relief and release frozen funds as part of a final deal, but only if Tehran offers “concrete progress” on the nuclear issue, a US official told CNN Monday, as mediators try to bring both countries back to the negotiating table.

CNN looks at the latest developments in the Iran war.

description:
President Donald Trump showed no sign he wants a slowdown in the development of AI technology after convening with top tech executives at the White House Tuesday, telling reporters afterward that he would sign an order renaming artificial intelligence “super intelligence” and praising the business leaders he had met with.

Flanked by the tech executives as he addressed reporters in the White House’s East Room, Trump said there was an “unbelievable feeling in this room,” and that the executives “want to do the right things.” Some of them have warned about the dangers of their own technology as episodes of AI agents going rogue pile up, though Trump has opposed any kind of slowdown in the development of the technology.
